name: Six Senses Southern Dunes
insider_take: Where endless dunes meet turquoise waters, this ultra-luxury retreat redefines Red Sea elegance with sustainable sophistication.
whats_special: Six Senses Southern Dunes sits within Saudi Arabia's ambitious Red Sea Project, featuring overwater and beachfront villas with direct coral reef access. The resort operates entirely on renewable energy and showcases cutting-edge marine conservation technology, including coral regeneration programs that guests can participate in.
pro_tip: Book the Overwater Villa with Marine Observatory - it features a glass-bottom living room for 24/7 reef viewing and comes with complimentary marine biologist-guided snorkeling sessions.
dont_miss: The world's first zero-waste spa built into natural sand dunes, offering treatments using locally-sourced desert minerals and sea salt. The resort's signature "Dune to Reef" experience includes sunset camel trekking followed by night diving with bioluminescent plankton - exclusive to this Red Sea location.
pros: Spectacular desert dune setting with Red Sea coastline access
Six Senses signature wellness programs and spa treatments
Sustainable luxury design integrated with natural landscape
Unique desert activities and stargazing experiences
cons: Remote desert location requires planned transportation
